default: Derived on demand by `scripts/generate census` from the units' census records (units/<id>/census.jsonl); never committed and never edited. The literal catalogs of one census area (D-063): every file whose literals are the documented keys of a domain. Write an entry with `scripts/census add <path> --catalog --domain <d> --holds <text> --why <why>`.
description: The description at the top of each rendered per-area catalog file.
